guide.dudunka.intro.title: Start a family adventure
guide.dudunka.intro.body: Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya hatch from rare eggs. Search suitable structure chests; Syusya eggs also occur in nature. Arrows turn pages and the mouse wheel scrolls. My family shows nearby companions and their commands. A lost album can be crafted again: book + paper + ink sac.
guide.dudunka.dudunka.title: Finding Dudunka
guide.dudunka.dudunka.body: Search house chests in plains, taiga, snowy, savanna and desert villages. Eggs are rare extra finds. Profession chests, such as blacksmith chests, are not included.
guide.dudunka.dudunka.mvs: MVS also offers eggs in common and desert houses and flower structures with loot.
guide.dudunka.marusya.title: Finding Marusya
guide.dudunka.marusya.body: Search abandoned mineshaft and woodland mansion chests. Prepare for the dangers of these places.
guide.dudunka.marusya.mvs: In MVS, check the Tall House: its abandoned-loot containers can contain an egg.
guide.dudunka.marusya.dungeons: In YUNG’s Better Dungeons, search common chests in skeleton and zombie dungeons.
guide.dudunka.syusya.title: Finding Syusya
guide.dudunka.syusya.body: Eggs can appear in ordinary monster-room chests.
guide.dudunka.syusya.mvs: In MVS, search swamp house chests.
guide.dudunka.syusya.dungeons: In YUNG’s Better Dungeons, search loot containers in small dungeons.
guide.dudunka.syusya.natural: In nature, look on grass or moss near water in swamps, mangrove swamps and lush caves. Natural eggs are placed blocks and appear only in newly generated chunks.
guide.dudunka.syusya.bop: Biomes O’ Plenty adds Bayou, Marsh and Wetland. Grass or moss, nearby water and free space are still required.
guide.dudunka.old_world.title: Playing an existing world
guide.dudunka.old_world.body: A new world is not required. An existing structure container can receive an egg if its loot has not yet been generated; ordinary chests usually generate it on first opening. Opened chests do not refill. Some mods generate loot early or separately for each player. Natural eggs require previously ungenerated chunks; existing terrain is not updated.
guide.dudunka.care.title: Helping an egg hatch
guide.dudunka.care.body: Place the egg and right-click with treats. Dudunka needs bread, apple and cookie, with a bed and light nearby. Marusya needs cod or salmon, nearby wool or carpet, and light level at most 7. Syusya needs leaves and a mushroom, grass or moss below, and nearby water. The first suitable offering claims ownership. Right-click shows readiness and time; missing conditions pause hatching.
guide.dudunka.rare: Eggs are not guaranteed. Reopening a chest whose loot was already generated does not provide another roll.
guide.dudunka.loot_disabled: Egg chest loot is disabled in this server’s settings.
guide.dudunka.natural_disabled: Natural egg generation is disabled in this server’s settings.

trail.dudunka.title: A Little Traveller’s Trail — %s/4
trail.dudunka.note_tooltip: Right-click to record in your album. You can share it with a friend.
trail.dudunka.read: Note saved. Open Egg Search in your Family Album; the story follows the guide.
trail.dudunka.already_read: This note is already in your album.
trail.dudunka.saved_ahead: Note saved for later. Find the earlier pages to read the story in order.
trail.dudunka.locked: This page is still locked. Find and read the next note; its location is hinted on the previous page.
trail.dudunka.no_guarantee: The egg remains rare. Notes help you search but do not guarantee it. An egg found early can be hatched immediately.
trail.dudunka.disabled: Notes are disabled by the server. Normal egg searching is still available.
trail.dudunka.step.0: She loved big adventures and little houses. Sometimes she left a trail of cookie crumbs…
trail.dudunka.step.1: “I saw a black cat today. She said the cosiest houses are easy to spot by their flowers.”
trail.dudunka.step.2: “A house can be above ground or beneath it. What matters is that something blooms nearby.”
trail.dudunka.step.3: “If you find my little egg, bring bread, an apple and a cookie. Leave a bed and a light nearby — I am a little afraid of the dark.”
trail.dudunka.hint.0.mvs: Look for the first note in ungenerated loot in ordinary village houses. Right-click to read it.
trail.dudunka.hint.0.vanilla: Look for the first note in ungenerated loot in ordinary village houses. Right-click to read it.
trail.dudunka.hint.1.mvs: The next note can appear in common loot in MVS residential buildings. Not every chest uses that table.
trail.dudunka.hint.1.vanilla: Without MVS, further notes can be found in other village-house chests whose loot has not yet generated.
trail.dudunka.hint.2.mvs: Look for flower loot in MVS Flower Hole and certain Deepslate House chests. They can contain the last note and the rare egg.
trail.dudunka.hint.2.vanilla: Without MVS, the final note and rare egg can appear in ordinary village-house chests. Explore more houses.
trail.dudunka.hint.3.mvs: Place the egg near a bed and light, then offer bread, an apple and a cookie. With valid conditions it hatches after five loaded minutes at default settings.
trail.dudunka.hint.3.vanilla: Place the egg near a bed and light, then offer bread, an apple and a cookie. With valid conditions it hatches after five loaded minutes at default settings.

story.dudunka.marusya.title: The cat who chose a home · %s / 4
story.dudunka.syusya.title: Little Syusya's great journey · %s / 4
story.dudunka.marusya.step.0: A black hair and a paw print remained on an old windowsill. Someone was clearly looking for the coziest home. Village chests may still hold notes about her.
story.dudunka.marusya.step.1: “I met a large black cat with yellow eyes. She inspected the house, sniffed the cushion and sat on my paper. I think the introduction went well.”
story.dudunka.marusya.step.2: “Marusya tested the scratching post. Then she stretched as diligently as if she were on duty. I drew her portrait — she sat on it again. Is that approval?”
story.dudunka.marusya.step.3: “That evening Marusya rested her chin on her paws and began to purr. I thought I had found a cat. It seems the cat had found herself a family.”
story.dudunka.syusya.step.0: A tiny note rests on a leaf: “Off to see the world. No rush to get far.” Village chests may hold the other pages of Syusya's journey.
story.dudunka.syusya.step.1: “Syusya set out from the moss to the big leaf. I offered her a lift, but she raised her feelers: important journeys are best made on your own.”
story.dudunka.syusya.step.2: “It began to drizzle. Syusya tucked in her feelers and hid. Then she peeked out: dry ground on the left, a leaf on the right. She decided to check the leaf first. A sensible route.”
story.dudunka.syusya.step.3: “Syusya reached her little house. Marusya waited nearby while I drew her shell. The journey was small, but we welcomed her like a true traveler.”
story.dudunka.marusya.places: All three notes can appear in ungenerated loot in ordinary village house chests, abandoned mineshafts and woodland mansions. Right-click to read a note.
story.dudunka.marusya.mvs: With MVS, notes can appear in abandoned loot, for example in Tall House.
story.dudunka.marusya.dungeons: With Better Dungeons, notes can appear in common loot in skeleton and zombie dungeons.
story.dudunka.syusya.places: All three notes can appear in ungenerated loot in ordinary village house chests and vanilla dungeon chests. Right-click to read a note.
story.dudunka.syusya.mvs: With MVS, notes can appear in swamp house loot.
story.dudunka.syusya.dungeons: With Better Dungeons, notes can appear in small dungeon loot piles.
screen.dudunka.help.page.0:
1. Find an egg!

Syusya: dungeon chests; her eggs can also appear in new swamps and lush caves.
Marusya: mineshafts and woodland mansions.
Dudunka: village house chests. Her egg is the rarest!

No egg yet? Keep exploring!
screen.dudunka.help.page.1:
2. Help it hatch

Place the egg. Hold a treat and right-click it.

Syusya: leaves block + mushroom; grass or moss below, water nearby.
Marusya: raw cod or salmon; wool or carpet nearby, a dark spot.
Dudunka: bread + apple + cookie; a bed and torch nearby.

Keep everything within two blocks. Click the egg again to see what is missing. Usually it takes five minutes nearby. Do not break a growing egg!
screen.dudunka.help.page.2:
3. Care and explore

Right-click with a treat; wait 30 seconds between treats.
Dudunka loves bread, apples and cookies. Marusya loves raw fish. Syusya loves leaves, mushrooms and apples.

Usually a baby needs 20 loaded minutes to become a teen, then 20 more to become an adult. Feeding helps. World settings can change these times.

Shift + right-click with an empty hand: wait or walk together again. Wait for Syusya — she is slow!

Stop for three seconds near a small flower: your friends may look at it together. Walk on to continue your outing.
screen.dudunka.help.page.3:
4. Make a cozy home

Under a roof, place a regular bed, chest or barrel, torch and cake. Add the friend’s home marker: Dudunka’s Bed, Marusya’s Cushion or Syusya’s House. Keep everything within four blocks of the marker.

Right-click the marker with your friend nearby. Its message tells you what is missing.

Add a drawing table, scratching bed or snail hut with a leaf. Leave the entrance clear!
Album → My family → choose a friend → Assign furniture → At home.

Place the friends’ home markers nearby and choose At home for everyone. When Dudunka shows a drawing, Marusya rests or Syusya peeks out, a free friend may come to watch. Leave clear floor in front of the furniture and stay nearby!

Add a glass window in an outside wall and a planted flower pot. During rain, friends may watch the window, rest together and inspect the pot.

Walk away from home for at least 10 seconds and come back: friends may greet you! The home must remain loaded. Close friends can settle together.
screen.dudunka.help.page.4:
5. Read and find stories

You get an album on your first join. Lost it? Craft another from a book, paper and an ink sac.

The egg guide has clues. My family shows your friends, Follow and Wait here. If your own friend is missing, try Recovery.

Found a note? Hold it and right-click. A story page is saved in your album, even when found out of order.

Explore, care and bring your little family together!

Album → choose a friend → Requests. Come closer, accept a request and press Help when ready. Skip without penalties. Right-click the keepsake to open it; the album retains your memory.

Memories keeps first milestones and captions from your friends. All family shows home, follow, wait and carrier states. A friend out of sight has last known information.
request.dudunka.commands: Accept a request, help, or skip it.
request.dudunka.scope: Nearby friends' requests. Come within 8 blocks of your friend.
request.dudunka.offer: A small kind deed is available. Press Accept first.
request.dudunka.active: Accepted. Your friend will wait as long as you need.
request.dudunka.cooldown: Another request in %s seconds of game time. Reopen the album to refresh.
request.dudunka.how.flower: Find one ordinary small flower, such as an oxeye daisy or dandelion. Come to Dudunka and press Help to give one from your inventory.
request.dudunka.how.cozy: Prepare a personal home: roof, bed, chest, light and cake. Assign matching furniture through the album. Come to your friend and press Help. An existing ready home counts too.
request.dudunka.how.treat: Right-click your friend with a favourite food, or press Help nearby to give one portion from your inventory. A full friend may need up to 30 seconds.
request.dudunka.optional: No deadlines, daily chores or penalties. Helping earns a keepsake, a memory here and a little trust. Helping or skipping starts a 10-minute game-time break before the next request.
request.dudunka.description.dudunka.flow: Dudunka: "Could you bring a small flower? I want to draw it before Marusya decides to sleep on it!"
request.dudunka.description.dudunka.trea: Dudunka: "A snack after our walk? An apple, bread or a cookie would be lovely!"
request.dudunka.description.marusya.cozy: Marusya: "Purr. Very important resting needs a cosy home and my own cat bed."
request.dudunka.description.marusya.trea: Marusya: "Resting calls for fish. Cod or salmon will do nicely."
request.dudunka.description.syusya.treat: Syusya: "I made it! An apple, mushroom or leaf, please? That was three whole steps."
request.dudunka.thanks.dudunka: Dudunka thanks you and gives you a keepsake drawing!
request.dudunka.thanks.marusya: Marusya purrs. You received a note about your kind deed!
request.dudunka.thanks.syusya: Syusya wiggles her feelers. You received a little note!
keepsake.dudunka.tooltip: Right-click to read. You can share it with another player.
screen.dudunka.result.request_accepted: Request accepted. Help whenever you like.
screen.dudunka.result.request_completed: Thank you! You received a keepsake and a memory.
screen.dudunka.result.request_not_ready: Not ready yet. Come closer and check items or home conditions. A full friend may need up to 30 seconds.
keepsake.dudunka.dudunka.flower: The drawing shows a flower with enormous glasses. "Now it is family too!"
keepsake.dudunka.dudunka.treat: Dudunka drew a picnic: the crumbs are bigger than Syusya. "We are just very small."
keepsake.dudunka.marusya.cozy: Marusya inspected every side of her bed. Verdict: "Purr. Approved for long naps."
keepsake.dudunka.marusya.treat: The fish disappeared. Marusya looks as though this is an important scientific discovery.
keepsake.dudunka.syusya.treat: Syusya: "Thanks for the treat! I wrote this slowly, but with all my shell."
memory.dudunka.note: First milestones for each kind of friend stay here. Days count from the start of the world. Real events create new entries.
memory.dudunka.empty: No entries yet. Our story is still ahead!

memory.dudunka.dudunka.hatched: I peeked out of my egg. Where’s my backpack?
memory.dudunka.dudunka.teen: I grew! Reaching the flowers is easier now.
memory.dudunka.dudunka.adult: I’m grown up now. I’ll still draw funny pictures!
memory.dudunka.dudunka.met_marusya: I met Marusya. What a huge fluffy friend!
memory.dudunka.dudunka.met_syusya: I met Syusya. I’ll take slower steps.
memory.dudunka.dudunka.shared_scene: I settled beside my friends. It’s cozier together.
memory.dudunka.marusya.hatched: I hatched. First, I’ll check for soft spots.
memory.dudunka.marusya.teen: I got longer. Tail, please keep up.
memory.dudunka.marusya.adult: I grew up. My fluffy collar needs a big pillow.
memory.dudunka.marusya.met_dudunka: I met Dudunka. She’s small, but very interesting.
memory.dudunka.marusya.met_syusya: I met Syusya. At last, someone who doesn’t rush.
memory.dudunka.marusya.shared_scene: I settled beside my friends. Purr. Good company.
memory.dudunka.syusya.hatched: I came out of my egg. The big world can wait while I look around.
memory.dudunka.syusya.teen: I grew. So did my shell. My speed stayed the same.
memory.dudunka.syusya.adult: I’m grown up. I still choose little steps.
memory.dudunka.syusya.met_dudunka: I met Dudunka. She knows how to wait for me.
memory.dudunka.syusya.met_marusya: I met Marusya. So much soft shade!
memory.dudunka.syusya.shared_scene: I finally reached my friends. My spot waited for me.
message.dudunka.pufik_greeting: Pufik: Hello! The Vale feels cozier with you here.
message.dudunka.vale_spider_greeting: Hello, friend! What a lovely day for a little wander.
message.dudunka.wise_fly_agaric.0: Every mushroom keeps a little story.
message.dudunka.wise_fly_agaric.1: Quiet... perhaps the Vale is remembering something.
message.dudunka.wise_fly_agaric.2: With friends nearby, even the forest sounds different.
message.dudunka.wise_fly_agaric.3: A good book is a little door to wonder.
message.dudunka.wise_fly_agaric.4: Take your time. There is so much to notice.
message.dudunka.wise_fly_agaric.5: Kind words make even a rainy day warmer.

message.dudunka.gateway.busy: Some friends are already awakening this gateway. Wait a little, then try again.
message.dudunka.gateway.missing: Bring your own living %s out beside the gateway, within %s blocks. Friends in a carrier or another place cannot join.
message.dudunka.gateway.young: %s needs to grow into an adult before helping the gateway.
message.dudunka.gateway.duplicate: The gateway found a repeated identity for %s. Ask a grown-up to check the family; nobody has been moved or changed.
message.dudunka.gateway.duplicate_kind: Bring just one of your %s friends within 8 blocks for this awakening.
message.dudunka.gateway.trust: %s has %s trust and needs %s. Care for your friend a little longer!
message.dudunka.gateway.settle: Let %s rest on dry ground, free from leads and rides, then try again.
message.dudunka.gateway.friend_busy: %s is helping another gateway. Wait for that awakening to finish.
message.dudunka.gateway.friendship: %s and %s have %s friendship and need %s. Enjoy some peaceful family time together!
message.dudunka.gateway.awakening: The three friends share a little magic… Stay nearby for three seconds!
message.dudunka.gateway.changed: The friends changed places or someone left. Gather the same three friends and try again.
message.dudunka.gateway.awakened: Your gateway is awake! Right-click again from safe ground to visit Mushroom Vale. Your friends stay here.
message.dudunka.gateway.return_hint: To go home from anywhere in Mushroom Vale, click %s in chat or type it. No special permission is needed.
message.dudunka.gateway.return_ready: A glowing return gateway is beside the arrival area. Right-click it to go home; your friends do not need to join.
message.dudunka.gateway.return_unavailab: There is no safe place for a return gateway here. Your way home is saved: use /dudunka return.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.entered: Welcome to Mushroom Vale! Your departure area is saved.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.returned: You are back beside your saved departure area.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.fallback: Your departure area was unavailable or unsafe, so you returned near the Overworld spawn.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.player_un: Travel while awake and free from rides or passengers. Spectators cannot use the gateway.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.already_t: You are already in Mushroom Vale. Use /dudunka return to go home.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.departure: Stand on safe solid ground beside the gateway with room above your head, then try again.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.unavailab: Mushroom Vale is unavailable. Ask a grown-up to check the server dimension data.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.arrival_u: The arrival area is unsafe. Stay here while a grown-up clears a safe landing in the valley, then try again.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.denied: The server could not allow this trip. Your position and return point are kept. Ask a grown-up to check the server rules.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.wrong_dim: Use /dudunka return while you are in Mushroom Vale.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.return_un: Your departure area and Overworld spawn are unsafe. Your return point is kept. Ask a grown-up to clear a safe landing, then try again.
message.dudunka.dev_family.disabled: Family preparation is unavailable. Start the local server with -Ddudunka.devMushroomVale=true and use an operator account.
message.dudunka.dev_family.player: Run this command as a living player in the Overworld.
message.dudunka.dev_family.repeated: A test family has already been prepared for you in this world.
message.dudunka.dev_family.existing: You already have a companion nearby. Move away from existing companions; this command will not alter them.
message.dudunka.dev_family.no_space: No safe, dry, clear ground was found nearby.
message.dudunka.dev_family.failed: The test family could not be created safely. Any companions created by this attempt were removed.
message.dudunka.dev_family.success: Test family ready nearby: Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya are adults, trustful and friends. Place and click the Family Gateway to test awakening.
mystery.dudunka.title: Mystery of Mushroom Vale
mystery.dudunka.snapshot: Close and reopen the album to see new events.
mystery.dudunka.text.1: Dudunka found a legend: an old mushroom arch sleeps in the forests! She drew mushrooms, moss and a tiny crystal. Explore forests you have not visited yet.
mystery.dudunka.text.2: Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya have grown up. They can share the secret together! Each needs trust 20, and every pair needs friendship 10. Feed your friends and rest together.
mystery.dudunka.text.3: Look for a mushroom arch with mossy stones and vines. Listen to the forest searches only nearby loaded land for an intact arch. Explore forests and listen again. Arches never appear by themselves in old places.
mystery.dudunka.text.4: We woke the gateway together! Dudunka waved, Marusya purred, and Syusya stretched her feelers. Three friendly seconds made a pink veil appear. A gateway at home opens the same secret.
mystery.dudunka.text.5: You visited Mushroom Vale for the first time! Meet Pufik, the Wise Fly Agaric, fireflies and fluffy jumpers. They welcome visitors. The return gateway leads home; your spare way out is /dudunka return.
mystery.dudunka.next.0: Bring your Dudunka nearby. She has a story! Stay together a little, then reopen the album.
mystery.dudunka.next.1: Help Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya grow up. Gather all three nearby, then reopen the album.
mystery.dudunka.next.2: Visit an Overworld forest. Stay a little, then reopen the album.
mystery.dudunka.next.3: Bring your three grown-up friends to an old arch or a gateway at home. Right-click and stay nearby for three seconds. A message will explain anything missing.
mystery.dudunka.next.4: Right-click the awakened gateway again while standing on safe ground nearby. A new memory is waiting!
mystery.dudunka.echo.locked: The forest is quiet for now. Continue your story.
mystery.dudunka.echo.not_searched: Press Listen to the forest to look for a nearby arch.
mystery.dudunka.echo.no_echo: No intact arch answered nearby. Explore new forests and try again. Not every forest has an arch.
mystery.dudunka.echo.other_dimension: Listen for a forest arch in the Overworld.
mystery.dudunka.echo.found: An intact arch was here when you last listened: X %s, Y %s, Z %s. Listen again after moving or changing the area.
mystery.dudunka.craft: You can craft a Family Gateway at home: 5 stone, a red and a brown mushroom, and an amethyst shard. Both paths lead to the same Vale.
message.dudunka.journey.missing: %s is missing. Gather all three of your companions within 8 blocks.
message.dudunka.journey.duplicate: More than one candidate or conflicting identity for %s. Separate the families and try again.
message.dudunka.journey.carried: Release %s from the carrier before family travel.
message.dudunka.journey.young: %s must be an adult for family travel.
message.dudunka.journey.follow: Ask %s to follow before family travel.
message.dudunka.journey.unsafe: %s needs safe dry ground, without a leash, passengers or a conflicting activity.
message.dudunka.journey.recover: Family rollback could not finish for %s. Use album recovery; the return bookmark was kept.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.family_in: Family travel needs all three eligible companions. Shift + right-click selects solo travel.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.rollback_: The family move failed and rollback was incomplete. Check the album recovery list.
message.dudunka.gateway.travel.preparing: Preparing the arrival area for your family. Stay here for a moment.
message.dudunka.music.welcome: Dudunka: Where did the first note go? Pufik left a listening clue! Right-click the amethyst crystal or the central carved stone, then tap the three mushroom stems.
message.dudunka.music.clue: Pufik’s listening clue: turquoise hums low, violet sings in the middle, golden rings high. Listen: turquoise → violet → golden. Dudunka: Tap their stems in that order; we can try as often as we like!
message.dudunka.music.clue_styled: Pufik’s listening clue: turquoise hums low, the rose-pink bell carries violet’s middle note, and amber-gold rings high. Listen: turquoise → rose-violet → golden. Dudunka: Tap their stems in that order; we can try as often as we like!
message.dudunka.music.correct: Dudunka: Yes, that note fits! Let’s try the next one.
message.dudunka.music.retry: Dudunka: A lovely sound! Let’s begin again with turquoise, then violet, then golden. Pufik’s crystal can sing it again.
message.dudunka.music.retry_styled: Dudunka: A lovely sound! Let’s begin again with turquoise, then rose-violet, then golden. Pufik’s crystal can sing it again.
message.dudunka.music.complete: Dudunka: We found the first melody! Pufik’s little tune is back in the Valley. Chapter “Where Did the First Note Go?” complete.
message.dudunka.music.again: Dudunka: Your first melody is safe! Play the bells for fun, or touch Pufik’s crystal to hear it again.
message.dudunka.dance.welcome: Marusya: The fluffy jumpers want to dance! Right-click the carved stone in the middle. Watch the sparkling flowers, then tap them to help the Valley dance. Take your time!
message.dudunka.dance.clue: Marusya: Two little hops, a bow, two little hops, a bow! Right-click the north flower twice, east once, south twice, west once. Watch the sparkles and direction clues. No need to keep time! Touch the stone to watch again.
message.dudunka.dance.beat.0: Marusya: North flower — a little hop! (North is toward decreasing Z.)
message.dudunka.dance.beat.1: Marusya: East flower — a bow! (East is toward increasing X.)
message.dudunka.dance.beat.2: Marusya: South flower — a little hop! (South is toward increasing Z.)
message.dudunka.dance.beat.3: Marusya: West flower — a bow! (West is toward decreasing X.)
message.dudunka.dance.correct: Marusya: That step fits! Continue whenever you like.
message.dudunka.dance.retry: Marusya: A lovely sound! Let’s try again: north twice, east once, south twice, west once. The stone can show us again.
message.dudunka.dance.completed: Marusya: Hooray! The fluffy jumpers’ dance is back in the Valley! Chapter “Dance of the Fluffy Jumpers” complete.
message.dudunka.dance.already_complete: Marusya: Your dance is safely remembered! Play any flowers for fun, or touch the stone to watch the dance again.
message.dudunka.dance.need_first_note: Marusya: First, help Dudunka and Pufik find the first melody at the mushroom bells. You can still listen to our flowers and watch the dance!
message.dudunka.memory.welcome: Syusya: At the bottom of the tall monument, find the row of three dark blocks with purple tears, just above the mossy base. Right-click the middle block to hear the story.
message.dudunka.memory.listen: Wise Fly Agaric: One evening, Syusya followed a little firefly through the dark forest. The firefly waited at each turn. Soon another joined, and they shared their glow until Syusya found the way home. Syusya: I remember how we helped one another. Which sign feels like a light shared?
message.dudunka.memory.beat.1: Wise Fly Agaric: A small light waited patiently at the first turn.
message.dudunka.memory.beat.2: The fireflies stayed together, sharing their little lights along the path.
message.dudunka.memory.beat.3: Syusya: The forest remembers each kind step. Choose one bright crystal, the pair of crystals, or the little corner lights.
message.dudunka.memory.listen_first: Wise Fly Agaric: First, right-click the middle dark block with purple tears in the lowest row, just above the mossy base. Listen to the story, then choose a sign.
message.dudunka.memory.need_first_note: Wise Fly Agaric: The first melody must return before the forest can remember its quiet voice. Visit the mushroom bells with Dudunka and Pufik.
message.dudunka.memory.need_dance: Syusya: The first melody is back. Now help Marusya and the fluffy jumpers restore their dance, then we can listen here again.
message.dudunka.memory.hint: Syusya: That sign holds a lovely memory too. Think about how the fireflies helped one another light the way. You can listen again or try another sign.
message.dudunka.memory.complete: Wise Fly Agaric: The Valley's quiet memory voice has returned. Syusya: We found it by listening patiently and remembering how to help. Chapter “The Forest That Remembers” complete.
message.dudunka.memory.again: Syusya: The forest’s memory is safe. To hear it again, right-click the middle dark block with purple tears in the lowest row, just above the mossy base.
message.dudunka.harp.welcome: Friendly mushroom spiders: We wove this silver harp to join the bell, dance and forest melodies! Bring Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya to listen together if you like. Right-click the three sparkling strings: west (toward decreasing X), middle, and east (toward increasing X). Each click cycles low → middle → high → low. Right-click the carved stone at the foot of the middle string to play them together. Nobody needs to stand in a special place.
message.dudunka.harp.clue: The spiders’ woven clue: west needs LOW (1 sparkle), middle needs HIGH (3 sparkles), east needs MIDDLE (2 sparkles). Dudunka: My first melody can be our deep, steady voice. Marusya: My dance can skip up high! Syusya: I will keep the forest’s quiet memory between them. Tune any string in any order, then play all three at the carved stone.
message.dudunka.harp.string.0: West string — Dudunka’s bell melody; needs LOW / 1 sparkle
message.dudunka.harp.string.1: Middle string — Marusya’s dance; needs HIGH / 3 sparkles
message.dudunka.harp.string.2: East string — Syusya’s forest memory; needs MIDDLE / 2 sparkles
message.dudunka.harp.retry: Friendly spiders: Almost woven together! Compare each string’s current tone with our clue. Your tuning stays as you left it. Change just the strings you want, then touch the carved stone again.
message.dudunka.harp.completed: The Silver Web sings with all three melodies! Dudunka: We did it together! Marusya: Purr-fect harmony! Syusya: Thank you, little weavers. Chapter “The Secret of the Silver Web” complete. You can keep tuning and playing for fun.
message.dudunka.harp.already_complete: Friendly spiders: Your Silver Web’s voice is safely remembered. Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya can enjoy this harmony with you again! Tune and play as often as you like.
message.dudunka.harp.need_first_note: Friendly spiders: First restore the bell melody with Dudunka and Pufik. Our harp joins all three earlier melodies.
message.dudunka.harp.need_dance: Friendly spiders: Now restore the fluffy jumpers’ dance with Marusya. Its melody will become our high voice.
message.dudunka.harp.need_memory: Friendly spiders: Listen to the Memory Stone with Syusya and restore the forest’s memory voice before tuning our harp.
message.dudunka.harp.spiders: The nearby mushroom spiders seem to applaud their woven harp. Their gentle little lights join yours!
message.dudunka.concert.welcome: A Song for All Friends! The Giant Singing Mushroom is waiting. Right-click its central carved stone to begin your family’s concert.
message.dudunka.concert.need_first_note: First, help Dudunka and Pufik bring back the three bell notes.
message.dudunka.concert.need_dance: Marusya’s fluffy jumper dance is still waiting for you.
message.dudunka.concert.need_memory: Listen to the forest memory with Syusya and the Wise Fly Agaric first.
message.dudunka.concert.need_harp: The friendly spiders’ Silver Web Harp still needs its harmony.
message.dudunka.concert.start: You brought every melody home! Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya each have a voice in this song. Stay nearby and listen; no friends need to stand in a special place.
message.dudunka.concert.bells: Dudunka’s first three notes ring out. This is where you and Pufik began!
message.dudunka.concert.dance: Tap-tap, hop, tap-tap, hop! Marusya’s melody remembers the fluffy jumpers’ flower dance.
message.dudunka.concert.memory: Syusya’s gentle chimes recall the shared light. The Wise Fly Agaric’s story and the fireflies’ glow belong in the song too.
message.dudunka.concert.harp: Low, high, middle: the friendly spiders’ silver strings weave the family’s voices into one warm chord.
message.dudunka.concert.together: Bells, dancing feet, memory lights and silver strings — together! You and your family gave every friend a place in the Valley’s song.
message.dudunka.concert.complete: The Valley’s music is restored! Thank you, dear friend. Your family’s song will always be welcome here. Right-click the stone whenever you wish to hear it again.
message.dudunka.concert.replay: An encore for all friends! Your family’s song is ready to bloom again.
message.dudunka.concert.encore: The Valley’s music shines again. Come back for another song whenever you like!
message.dudunka.concert.cancelled: The mushroom will save a place for you. Come back and right-click the stone to begin the song again.
message.dudunka.concert.nearby: Friends nearby sparkle with applause — a little celebration just for you!
